notes.notes:

notes.title: Update 3 for v0.9.9.7 is here with improved performance and more !
notes.notes:
This update brings up to 30% performance improvements

Here's what's in this update


 New : it is now possible to sell cars
 New : Switched to the faster script execution system in Unity engine


 Improved : Overall game performance improvements, up to 30%
 Improved : UI elements navigation in Challenges mode. Navigating UI elements can now be done while holding down keys


 Fixed : Gamepad/Controller input : Dead Zones have been internally added to input bindings which filters the unwanted values
 Fixed : Player were able to go back to main menu while navigating car list and press escape key which would result in automatic car list navigation

notes.title: v0.9.9.7 Update 2 brings improved steering wheel support
notes.notes:
v0.9.9.7.2 is here and brings some nice improvements


 New : Added common presets for Logitech and Thrustmaster wheels under "Steering Wheel" tab in "GameSettings/Input" panel to use as a starting point for setting up wheels


 Improved : Steering wheel controls. Players can now enjoy smooth car weight transition using a steering wheel
 Improved : The vehicle tires are now completely dynamically generated at runtime. This would allow for adding an option for players to adjust tire profile later
 Improved : Tire texture
 Improved : Brakes do not block the wheels anymore, instead the car brakes much smoother now !
 Improved : Improved original camera rotation damp values, which removes some strange camera rotations
 Improved : Improved camera settings panel
 Improved : Some parts of the User Interface


 Fixed : Camera lean state was kept when switching from "Action Camera" to another camera mode instead of being reset
 Fixed : Camera "Look At" mode height wasn't properly set when players switch to that mode. The camera now takes the car's vertical position into consideration to position itself correctly
 Fixed : Brakes distribution option in tuning was not implemented. The setting now affects the braking by distributing the braking torque properly between front and rear axles
 Fixed : Car skidding sound effects was still playing when the car is in air

notes.title: 5th major update is here !
notes.notes:
The 5th major update brings some exciting new features !

What's new


 Create your dream livery using the new advanced custom Livery System available now in the game
 Setup the weather using the Clear, Cloudy, Rainy or some of the other presets using the new Weather system added to the game
 Setup day time. Choose a specific time or match local with automated day/night cycle
 New garage level
 All cars have now unique names
 Added a new drift track ( WORK IN PROGRESS )
 Added game settings reset option available for all setting groups including per device reset for input


What's improved


 Improved key rebind functionality. Players can now replace an existing control when rebinding keys
 Added support for steering wheels using two pedals
 Car paint shader
 Added more values for FPS limit ( 72Hz, 150Hz and 300Hz )


What's fixed


 The money glitch

notes.title: A quick patch for fixing clutch input in "Third Official Update"
notes.notes: FIXED : clutch input initial state in "Third Official Update" v 0.9.9.3 beta was wrong which was resulting in the car not being able to move unless clutch button is pressed...

notes.title: Third update is here !
notes.notes:
Steering Wheel Notes :
     

NOTE : steering wheel support is still experimental
 NOTE : proper CLUTCH is not yet implemented for steering wheels
NOTE : select "Steering Wheel" setup in game settings main menu when using the wheel
NOTE : force multiplier and dead zone settings will be added later     
NOTE : it works well with "counter steer" and "high speed steer assist" settings enabled
NOTE : Official support for Logitech wheels should come soon... currently Thrustmaster wheels are officially supported


Added : more challenges. Tier 1 and 2 are now completed including 15 challenges each
Added : progress bar for track and lap based events


Fixed : settings in GameSettings window should now be visible
Fixed : an issue with game breaking bug related to detecting controllers and devices
Fixed : steering wheels can now be plugged even if the game is running ( no more need to plug in steering wheels before run the game )
Fixed : drift distance for first Free Drift area was adjusted to 10,000m, was previously 100,000m
Fixed : warning icon for tires wear was still visible if tires were changed at runtime
Fixed : engine tune UI was always showing Stock in upper right corner of the runtime UI
Fixed : fixed missing wall colliders in the Port level
Fixed : some Reset positions
Fixed : many small internal fixes and improvements


Improved : "Drift" tune was adjusted in order to improve the car stability
Improved : drift distance is now accumulated on car crash
Improved : control type for input bindings were changed in order to allow for detecting more input types as pedals in steering wheel sets


Changed : leaderboards in challenges mode are now setup per Tier and not per challenge

notes.title: Second Major Update is out now !
notes.notes:
The second Official Update is out now... It brings overall improvements and game polish !

* Added a tutorial
* Added clutch
* Added Manual and Semi-Automatic gearbox
* Added an option to swap tires and tune suspension while in game ( enter Tune from Pause Menu )
* Added a new Oval Racing Track in "Free Drift" mode ( the track is WIP )
* Added car names to some cars (other car names will be added later)
* Added a new Input binding for Cruise Mode and another input to bypass The Cruise Mode
* Added settings in GameSettings, to toggle UI elements as MiniMap, Dashboard etc.	
* Added inertia tensor multiplier to settings (read the tooltip in GameSettings)
* Added new inputs for Clutch, ShiftUp and ShiftDown into key binding settings
* Added more suspension presets ( drift soft and race soft ) and camber and offset to all presets
* Added info (tooltip) for every setting in "Settings"
* Added Engine Limiter toggle option in settings
* Added windows tint to car paint options
* Added caliper and smoke paint to car paint options
* Added suspension settings per axle

* Improved garage user experience and navigation 
* Improved "CarInfoPanel" in garage
* Improved Driver View camera sway
* Improved 180 turns

* Changed : Original car tune is added back ( with some changes ). Choose the "Drift" or "Power Slide" tunes in Garage/Engine
* Changed : Orbit camera is returned in garage when enter garage settings
* Changed : CruiseMode UI is always visible now
* Changed : CounterSteer is changed to slider in settings
* Changed : Separate race and drift cameras to allow switching to loose cameras while in game
* Changed : default camera side look key bindings are changed to Q,W,E ( prev A,S,D)
* Changed : Rim painting is moved to the car paint tune manager
* Changed : Metallic and smoothness adjustments per rim id in rim color paint	
* Changed : "In Game Menu" toggle is moved by default to D-Pad down when using controller
* Changed : Switching from VSync to frame limit setting - can choose from most of the standard monitor Hz ( VSync option may be added back to the game if needed later )

* Fixed : multiplayer issues and screen freeze
* Fixed : turbo whistle was not working when engine is reached max rpm

* NOTE : Game Settings will not be loaded from previous saved version to prevent game breaking

* Known Issue : throttle and brake/handbrake can not work together...

notes.title: Second Major Update coming soon !
notes.notes:
Second major update coming soon...
The next update is in the work. Here are some of the things that have been implemented:

* Added clutch input
* Added manual shifting
* Improved automatic gearbox and driving in reverse
* Engine specs were improved for all cars ( based on real cars specs )
* Different engine sounds have been added to cars
* Engine upgrades are changed with unlocking tune setups - we have now Stock, Drift and PowerSlide tunes
* Painting rims has been moved to an appropriate paint sub panel...
* Windows tint is also added ( available in the same paint sub panel )
* First Person Camera were separated into two different modes - TPS Drift and TPS Racing
* Fixed engine Limiter ( gas cutout ) and added an option to settings to toggle on/off that feature
* Added another track to free drift mode
* and more...
